1. What is the Dubai Retirement Visa?

The Retirement Visa for Dubai is a special residency program. Specifically designed for expatriates aged 55 and above. The visa allows them to live in Dubai after retirement. It offers long-term residency benefits for retirees who meet specific financial criteria, such as:

  • Income
  • Savings, or
  • Property ownership.

The program aims to attract retirees globally. Providing a high standard of living while having access to quality healthcare. At the same time, an opportunity to enjoy Dubai’s vibrant lifestyle. A great option for retirees to spend their golden years in a luxurious city.

KPMPro is with you to make this a reality. Achieve your dream life by just reaching out to experts. The life you dreamed of is just a step away!

2. Eligibility Criteria for the Dubai Retirement Visa

Are you planning to acquire a retirement visa? Discover how to apply for retirement visa in Dubai. You can apply for a 5-year long-term visa. To be eligible, you must have:

Financial Criteria:

As a retiree, you earn a sustainable yearly income of at least AED180,000 which is approx. US$49,000 from any source. The amount equates to AED15,000 which is approx. US$4,100 per month.

Age and Residency Requirements

Applicants 55 years of age can apply for a Visa. The retirement visa has a 5-year validity. This is specially designed for those who want to live in Dubai after retirement. Obtain a 5-year renewable residence Visa as a retiree. Note that, meet certain requirements to apply for it.

Property Ownership Requirements (if applicable)

The visa holder must have AED1 million which is approx. US$275,000 in unmortgaged property or mortgaged property.

Additionally, you are still eligible if you have savings and property worth AED1 million (approx. US$275,000). Let’s say a 3-year fixed deposit and property, worth AED500,000 each

3. Documents Required for the Retirement Visa Application

To apply for the long-term residency Visa, acquire the following documents:

List of Necessary Documents

  • The property value stated in the title deed must be at least 1 million AED
  • Applicant age must be 55 years or older
  • Passport copy (Valid for more than 6 months).
  • Old Emirates ID
  • A high-quality applicant digital photo
  • Applicants from IRAN, PAKISTAN, IRAQ, LIBYA, and AFGHANISTAN must bring their National ID 
  • Health insurance is required from insurance companies in the UAE

Passport and ID

The applicant must submit a passport copy with a validity of 6 months. Additionally, if he/she was a resident of UAE, they must be required to submit their old Emirates ID

Proof of Income or Savings

To apply for a retirement visa, you should have a steady income and savings. Anyone of them can make you eligible for the visa

Property Ownership (if applicable)

You must own a property of AED1 million. It is approximately US$275,000 in unmortgaged property or mortgaged property.

With these requirements fulfilled, this is how to apply for retirement visa in Dubai!

4. The Step-by-Step Process to Apply for the Dubai Retirement Visa

Before starting your journey to obtain a retirement visa, here is the step-by-step process to apply for it:

Step 1: Initial Consultation and Eligibility Check

Firstly, assess the eligibility criteria for the Dubai Retirement Visa. Check whether you meet the requirements or not. Consult with the authorities or a visa consultant to confirm that you meet the age, income, and financial requirements.

Step 2: Document Preparation and Submission

On confirming eligibility, the second step is to gather the necessary documents. Documents must be submitted to the relevant authorities. If required, take the help of a visa service provider/consultant for a seamless process.

Step 3: Application Review by the Authorities

At this stage, the Dubai authorities will review your application and documents. They verify your eligibility and ensure compliance with the visa requirements. Note that, this process may take a few weeks. However, it depends on application completeness and the speed of government processing.

Step 4: Visa Approval and Residency Status

Receive your retirement visa, once your application is approved. The visa grants you legal residency in Dubai. With this visa, you can live, travel, and enjoy the benefits of retirement. Further, you can have access to healthcare and other services.

5. How Long Does the Dubai Retirement Visa Last?

The Dubai retirement visa is valid for 5 years. The visa has the possibility of renewing. Given that if they meet the eligibility criteria.

6. Common Challenges in Applying for a Dubai Retirement Visa

There are a few common challenges that applicants may face. Particularly when applying for a Dubai Retirement Visa. We share some of the key hurdles to be aware of:

Meeting Financial Eligibility Criteria 

The biggest challenge is meeting the ]financial requirements set by the Dubai authorities. The visa applicants need to prove a certain income level, savings, or property ownership.

Document Compilation and Verification 

Gathering the required documents is another huge challenge. These may include

  • Proof of age
  • Health insurance
  • Bank statements
  • Property ownership, or
  • Rental agreements can be time-consuming and complex.

Health Insurance Requirements

Applicants must have valid health insurance. This is essential to qualify for the retirement visa. Finding health coverage that meets the requirements can be a challenge. Especially the health insurance that is both affordable and comprehensive.

Processing Time and Delays

The application review process can sometimes take longer than expected. This is due to various factors, including:

  • The volume of applications or
  • Delays in document verification

Age and Residency Status Confusion

Some applicants may face confusion around the age requirement. They don’t understand the length of time they need to stay in Dubai to maintain their residency status. The visa is designed for people aged 55 and above. However, there may be additional considerations on how long you must live in Dubai each year to retain your visa.

The challenges discussed above won’t haunt you if you have KPMPro by your side! Give us a try and we’ll handle it for you. Whether it be visa processing delays or gathering required documents, the team understands well what is needed to fulfill.

FAQs:

What is the Dubai Retirement Visa?

It is a long-term residency option for individuals aged 55 and above who meet specific financial criteria.

Who is eligible to apply for a retirement visa in Dubai?

Applicants must meet income, investment, or savings requirements to qualify.

What documents are required to apply for a retirement visa in Dubai?

Passport copies, proof of income or savings, medical insurance, and supporting financial documents.

How long does it take to process a retirement visa application?

Processing times vary and depend on approvals and documentation accuracy.

What happens if my financial status changes after obtaining the visa?

You must continue meeting the required criteria when renewing the visa.

Can I apply for the Dubai retirement visa from outside the UAE?

Yes. Applications can be submitted from abroad with the required documentation.
